status: Locked research design and model provenance only; no held-out source labels or images accessed; no independent study executed
goal: Test whether fixed, original blood-CNN score prioritization preserves more distinct corrected-source blood-positive annotation runs than equal-workload uniform on genuinely unexamined Galar examinations.

scope.label: Corrected publisher blood=1 annotation; not diagnosis, active bleeding, unique lesions, or physician time

original_model.score: raw uncalibrated softmax for blood-present class; NEVER a calibrated clinical risk

publisher.positive_run_definition: Maximal consecutive corrected blood=1 annotated rows with original source-frame index increasing exactly 5
publisher.eligible_candidate_population: All explicit binary blood-labelled source-index positions for each locked examination, with original image bytes independently verified at each position; otherwise stop and report a coverage failure, not an apparent model outcome
publisher.missing_or_blank_labels: Unknown, not negative; exclude and report. Never interpolate frames, times, source runs or labels.

methods.exact_k_rule: For integer percent p and N eligible imported positions: max(1, floor((N*p+50)/100)), with K capped at N. Research operating points only; product permits any K.

endpoints.primary: Paired, examination-level difference score_bin minus uniform in distinct corrected blood-positive annotation-run recall at 10% equal workload; choose a bounded-coverage method before accessing holdout labels.
secondary: All four policies at all prespecified workloads
Per-examination and pooled positive annotated run counts
Exact K and imported-position omission maxima
Frame-level positive hits labelled as secondary, not source-run/lesion sensitivity
Examination-level leave-one-out variation; insufficient exam support reported as such
endpoints.negative_examinations: Run recall undefined if zero explicit blood-positive runs; still report total selected images and ranking/coverage technical outcomes.
endpoints.uncertainty: Resample examinations only if exchangeability can reasonably be defended; do not present confidence intervals or p-values as patient-independent when identities unavailable.

acceptance_gates: Preserved model checkpoint and exact original-package SHA-256 independently verified, no weight loading in preflight.
Lock evaluation protocol in public Git BEFORE examining 11–20 source labels/pixels or scoring them.
Acquire all eligible original annotated positions with verified source hashes and licence; do not use sparse sample as full source.
Run fixed model and four existing score-blind-to-label policies on imported original images without holdout feedback.
Freeze predictions and image/source identity hashes before opening only the permitted locked evaluation CSV members.
Report every examination and budget, including zero-positive and worse-than-uniform results; no model promotion or clinical validity claim.

privacy.public_outputs: Only non-identifying aggregate outcomes, frozen code/protocol, synthetic tests, and reproducibility receipts.
